transparency.title: Transparency notes
notes: Estimates based on Auxo Systems’ internal pricing grid. Indicative amounts in Canadian dollars, before taxes. This estimate does not constitute a contractual quote.
Auxo Systems’ internal pricing grid was revised on August 3, 2026. It is not presented as a benchmark for the Quebec market.
Applicable taxes will be determined in any official quote based on the client’s location.
Third-party costs (hosting, licenses, etc.) are paid directly by the client and may vary.
Your answers and calculations stay in your browser. The PDF report is generated locally on your device.
The maintenance plan and baseline third-party costs are assigned automatically by scenario; they are not selected in the wizard.
